title: Zipmex begins operating
description: Zipmex developed as a regional cryptocurrency exchange serving Southeast Asian and Australian markets and later offered ZipUp yield products.

title: Zipmex suspends withdrawals
description: Zipmex suspended Thai baht and digital-asset withdrawals. ZipUp and ZipUp+ customer assets were affected by exposure to external lending platforms including Celsius Network and Babel Finance.
notes: Some ordinary wallet functions were later partially restored, but ZipUp-related access and recovery remained impaired.

title: Zipmex Group files Singapore moratorium applications
description: Five Zipmex Group entities applied to the Singapore High Court for moratorium protection under section 64 of the Insolvency, Restructuring and Dissolution Act.
notes: The applications triggered interim protection and began a prolonged court-supervised restructuring attempt.

title: Inter-linked Zipmex schemes fail
description: Zipmex Asia's proposed scheme obtained the required majority but Zipmex Singapore's did not. Because the two schemes were inter-linked and inter-conditional, neither could be implemented.
notes: The failed vote ended the proposed inter-linked restructuring path.

title: Singapore High Court dismisses further moratorium extensions
description: The High Court dismissed applications to extend the Zipmex Group moratoria because there was no further prospect of restructuring under the proposed schemes.
notes: The judgment stated that liquidation of constituent companies was likely to be imminent.

title: Court winds up Zipmex Singapore
description: Zipmex Pte Ltd was wound up by the Singapore High Court and a liquidator was appointed.
notes: This date applies to the Singapore operating entity rather than every company in the group.

title: Thailand revokes Zipmex exchange and broker licenses
description: Thailand's Minister of Finance revoked Zipmex's digital-asset exchange and broker licenses after the company failed to complete required rectification measures. The company remained responsible for returning client assets.
notes: The revocation was effective on 28 May 2024 and concerned the Thai licensed entity.

title: Court sets aside Zipmex Asia creditor-meeting resolutions
description: The Singapore High Court set aside resolutions purportedly passed at a Zipmex Asia creditors' meeting because of substantive irregularities and stated that the court would appoint a liquidator.
notes: The decision concerned the validity of the Zipmex Asia liquidation process and creditor voting.
